sqlTemplate:
WITH active_art_base AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT client_id
    FROM (
        SELECT client_id FROM mamba_fact_patients_latest_arv_order
        WHERE is_active_on_art = 1
          AND coverage_start_date <= :endDate
          AND (coverage_end_date >= :endDate - INTERVAL 90 DAY OR coverage_end_date IS NULL)
        UNION
        SELECT client_id FROM mamba_fact_patients_latest_return_date
        WHERE return_date >= :endDate - INTERVAL 90 DAY AND return_date <= :endDate
    ) as potential_active
    WHERE client_id NOT IN (
        SELECT client_id FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_summary
        WHERE transfer_out_date IS NOT NULL AND transfer_out_date <= :endDate
    )
    AND client_id NOT IN (
        SELECT person_id FROM person
        WHERE dead = 1 AND death_date <= :endDate
    )
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT arv.client_id) AS total
FROM active_art_base base
INNER JOIN mamba_fact_patients_latest_arv_order arv ON base.client_id = arv.client_id
INNER JOIN mamba_fact_patients_latest_nutrition_assesment na ON arv.client_id = na.client_id
INNER JOIN mamba_fact_patients_latest_nutrition_support ns ON arv.client_id = ns.client_id
WHERE na.status IN ("UNDERWEIGHT", "MODERATE ACUTE MALNUTRITION", "SEVERE ACUTE MALNUTRITION", "SEVERE ACUTE MALNUTRITION WITH OEDEMA")
  AND ns.status IS NOT NULL
  AND ns.status != "Not enrolled after nutrition counselling"
